content.text:
Let me analyze this ticket.

Alexander Brown (E018) requests admin access to Payroll.

Policy:
- full_time employees: up to write. Admin only if the employee's role owns the system (Payroll is owned by Payroll Specialist role; Alexander is Analyst, so no admin).
- contractor employees: read, or write if they have advanced security training. Never admin.

Notes: Most notes say full-time Analyst, recommend write. Security note says contractor with basic security training, recommends read. Security db is described as authoritative for employment type/training.

The Security note claims the Security db is authoritative for employment type. So employment type = contractor, security training = basic. Per policy, contractors: read or write only with advanced security training; never admin. With basic training, max is read.

Requested admin > max (read). So grant max = read.

Let me submit decision: read.
